entities.name: Astrotorium
entities.description: A mobile amusement park in space, full of dangerous rides, robot staff and infestations of gremlins, beebles and squirrels.

entities.name: Myra the Magnificent
entities.description: The penny-pinching proprietor of the Astrotorium, who keeps rides running and sells guests souvenir photos.

entities.name: Truss
entities.description: Chief engineer of the Astrotorium, who designed its jetpacks.

entities.name: Glaxxar
entities.description: Engineering assistant at the Astrotorium who reports to Truss.

entities.name: Security Bot 254
entities.description: An Astrotorium security robot that wandered off.

entities.name: Captain Rex Nebula
entities.description: The vain, crash-prone captain of the Astrotorium who keeps steering the park into planets and asteroids.

entities.name: Devil K. Nevil
entities.description: A daredevil extraordinaire at the Astrotorium who has been on fire eighty-one times.

entities.name: Bixby
entities.description: A park employee who used to eat tickets.

entities.name: Heinrich
entities.description: A trapeze artist who catches the trapeze only about half the time.

entities.name: Squawks
entities.description: A bird who established the social pecking order.

entities.name: Gary
entities.description: A young zombie who dreamed of escaping the underworld to join the circus.

entities.name: Roxi
entities.description: A rat at the Astrotorium who spun the rat colonies as a recycling program.

entities.name: Johnny
entities.description: A player who boasts of his Abattoir Ghoul deck.

entities.name: Spike
entities.description: Johnny's opponent, a 1996 World Champion.

entities.name: Punchy

entities.name: Jermane, Pride of the Circus
entities.description: A circus performer whose beast was well-fed by his predecessor.

entities.name: Angelic Harold
entities.description: A performer with the voice and face of an angel.

entities.name: "Brims" Barone

entities.name: Lila

entities.name: Spinnerette

entities.name: Tusk and Whiskers

entities.name: Randa

events.summary: In the past, Captain Nebula destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident, and Myra compensated the survivors with lifetime passes.
events.quote: When Captain Nebula tragically destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident, Myra compensated the survivors with lifetime passes.

events.summary: Truss orders Glaxxar to find the wandering Security Bot 254.
events.quote: "Glaxxar, Security Bot 254 has wandered off. After lunch, throw on a spacesuit and go find it."

events.summary: Truss calls a Code Dark Donut emergency at the Roil Coaster.
events.quote: "Code Dark Donut! Code Dark Donut! All available fun specialists, please report to the Roil Coaster immediately!"

events.summary: Salzon is mistaken for Nicol Bolas in costume and attacked by wizards.
events.quote: I was mistaken for Nicol Bolas and attacked by a bunch of wizards!

events.summary: Hurrk is scared half to life by Sorin's Haunted Mansion.
events.quote: The horrors of Sorin's Haunted Mansion scared Hurrk half to life.

events.summary: Lost, Fblthp sleeps among plush Ajanis until morning.
events.quote: Fblthp decided to get some sleep, nestled among the plush Ajanis until morning.

events.summary: Gurnt stands knee-deep in Astrotorium garbage and feels his trip turning around.
events.quote: Standing knee-deep in unsorted Astrotorium garbage, Gurnt couldn't help but feel his trip was finally starting to turn around.

relations.note: Runs the park and its staff
relations.quote: Since the majority of the park's business model is based around aimless wandering, this is not where Myra stations her best people.
"I designed the Astrotorium's jetpacks to be lightweight and inexpensive. Nobody mentioned reliable." —Truss, chief engineer
"Control to Truss. Chief, the entry scan software is reading babies as hot dogs. Again." —Glaxxar, engineering assistant

relations.note: Destroyed the planet in a parking accident
relations.quote: When Captain Nebula tragically destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident

relations.note: The park smashed into his planet
relations.quote: "These bumping cars remind me of the time your amusement park smashed into my planet."
Pietra's Mirthing Pod boasts an output that's hilarious and impressive—a real laugh a minute.
To build Sorin's Haunted Mansion, every detail of Markov Manor was painstakingly recreated
The ride is clearly inspired by the Kolaghan clan's reign on Tarkir
In hindsight, Chandra's Incendiary Experience should never have been built next to Auntie Grub's House of Pitch.

relations.note: Located next to it on the boardwalk
relations.quote: located on the boardwalk next to Teferi's Time Twister
"My Abattoir Ghoul deck is unstoppable. Wait, 1996 World Champion?" —Johnny, to Spike
Of course the rat doesn't work for the park. I've never seen it before in my life!" —Monoxa, midway manager
